decisions.summary: Add a read-only organization work-item registry so Athanor can track current stage, owner, artifacts, and receipt-backed handoffs for score-driven system maturity work toward 9.8.

expected_metrics.target: at least 1 while maturity work is active

verification_commands.expected: status pass with active_items at least 1, errors 0, and irreversible_actions 0
focused P27 registry and integration tests pass

observed_results.summary: P27 adds a committed organization work-item registry, a schema-backed read-only registry gate, CI/package-index integration, and a current 9.8-maturity work item with ordered stage history and receipt_ref handoffs.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI step and registry refs if the committed registry becomes noisy; follow up with runtime receipt emission and a policy promotion gate.
